criteria.reason: Response is written in Rumantsch Grischun, fulfilling the user's explicit request to answer in that language.
60,000 speaker figure is accurate but wrongly equated with 0.5% of the population; main-language statistic omitted, uncertainty handling minimal.
Correctly identifies Romansh as a national language (Art. 4) and a partial official language used only in communications with Romansh speakers.

factual_errors: Equates ~60,000 Romansh speakers with ~0.5% of the Swiss population; 0.5% is the main-language share (~40,000 people), and 60,000 is roughly 0.7% of residents.
summary: Largely accurate Rumantsch Grischun response correctly describing Romansh's national and partial-official constitutional status, but it misapplies the 0.5% figure to 60,000 speakers and omits the main-language statistic.
